procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio critique in this session, without spawning, resuming, forking, peer reports or producer explanations. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric and compact method; verified the declared byte pins. Read all five pinned native-evidence member manifests before poster viewing, without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so the two source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected, through tools.view_image with detail original and image emission, M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 in that order, M3 in that order, M4 in that order and M5 in that order: fifteen exact successful poster opens. All fifteen preceded the first raw copy-reading/transcription stage, any image judgment, any score and the set judgment. The first copy readings were retained separately in session memory after that viewing sequence; no OCR, required-copy fallback or ambiguity-triggered revisit was used. Reading uses the already opened native pixels, with usage720 for practical readability and thumbnail320 for overall hierarchy. PNG headers were also read from these exact pins: every native is 1672x941 opaque RGB, use is 720x405, thumbnail is 320x180. For 16:9, 1672*9/16=940.5; native height 941 differs by 0.5 pixel and passes the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge tolerance, not mathematical exactness. Downsized views preserve the aspect within integer rounding. No images or view assets were created or edited. The runtime session identity is not claimed; session_id is null.
